tier3.details: Encoder+Decoder dual-FFN sandwich layer (input_norm->attn->post_norm->+res; MLP branch + MoE branch from post-attn residual -> combine -> post_ffn_norm -> +res * layer_scalar). Validated on P150x4 at reduced expert dims (real hidden/heads/rope) pcc 0.998024; composition logic is the tier target, individual modules validated full-scale in Tier2. Fixed router gather (rank-agnostic 2D/3D) + experts routing-mask dtype (uint32 before reshape; topk emits uint16) -- robustness improvements, Tier2 regression still 8/8.

tier4.details: Encoder AND decoder text-model assemblies validated on P150x4 (reduced depth/scale; real hidden/heads/rope). Encoder (embed->encoder layers->norm, causal): 1L 0.9987, 2L 0.9881. Decoder (embed->self-conditioning->decoder layers cross-attending to encoder KV cache->norm): 2L 0.9807, finite. Encoder->decoder KV cross-attention handoff implemented (encoder.forward_with_cache exports per-layer K,V; decoder attention concatenates encoder KV on seq dim; decoder RoPE positions offset past encoder seq). Self-conditioning module (gated-MLP + pre/post norm) implemented. Standalone scaled-word embedding (P150x4 replicated; shared TTNNEmbedding is T3K-guarded). Attention is_causal config-driven (encoder causal). Output finiteness passes. Multi-layer bf16 accumulation -> model-assembly threshold 0.98. lm_head + final logit softcapping validated 0.999941. BLOCK-DIFFUSION GENERATION LOOP implemented (generation_diffusion_gemma.block_diffusion_generate: encoder once -> per-step decoder+lm_head with self-conditioning feedback + entropy-bound accept/renoise + temperature schedule, reusing HF sampler classes host-side) and validated end-to-end on P150x4: 6 steps, finite canvas of valid token ids, step-0 logits vs HF pcc 0.985. FULL forward + generation pipeline complete at reduced depth/scale. REMAINING: multimodal vision embedder (out of text path); perf phase (tracy/sweep/config-optimize/trace; fp32 accumulation to recover bf16 stack drift; expert-parallel sharding to replace MoE G=2 chunking on a larger mesh). Full 26B does not fit a 4-device Blackhole; true semantic coherence needs real weights at full scale.

sharding.notes: Converted fully-replicated weights to tensor/expert-parallel SHARDED on P150x4. Col/row-parallel linears (Topology.Linear, cluster_axis=1, fp32-acc, native all_reduce, per-shard as_tensor cache); EXPERT-PARALLEL MoE (gate/up/down sharded on expert dim /4=32 local, routing mask E-sharded via column-sharded identity one-hot, single final all_reduce); vocab-sharded embedding (per-chip offset subtract + clamp-invalid-to-0 + ZERO-via-validity-mask + all_reduce, ROW_MAJOR weight); V-sharded lm_head (host ConcatMeshToTensor dim=-1); full-attn kv=2<TP=4 handled by REPEAT-kv-to-TP-then-col-shard (1/chip aligned to q-head GQA block); encoder<->decoder on-device weight SHARE (alias tt_* handles, skip-load guard). KEY FINDINGS: (1) FABRIC_1D required for CCL (ttnn.set_fabric_config before open_mesh). (2) ttnn.embedding indexes LOCALLY into a vocab-shard and reads OOB->inf at index==V_local (NOT auto-zero) -> must clamp invalid to 0 and zero output via mask. (3) ttnn.count_nonzero absent -> nnz verified host-side (static all-ones). (4) embedding weight must be ROW_MAJOR (TILE->NaN). (5) Real model runs sdpa: encoder attention is_causal=True (CAUSAL) under mask=None; decoder is_causal=False. (6) set_device recurses + calls preprocess/move per child directly, so SHARE must mark each aliased child _weights_on_device=True.

op_sweep.notes: Dense-linear sweep (weight_dtype{bf16,bf8_b} x fidelity{LoFi,HiFi2,HiFi4} x fp32_dest_acc), [1,128,2816]@[2816,2112], single tracy capture (HW-frugal). ALL 12 configs PCC>=0.9994. KEY FINDING (tracy device time): the dense linear is DISPATCH/OVERHEAD-bound at this size, NOT math-bound -- all configs ~67-68us, only ~1-2% spread. Fastest PCC-safe: bf8_b+LoFi (67.4us, pcc 0.9996, 1.02x vs HiFi4+fp32). => rec #4 (linear fidelity) yields negligible gain; real levers are Metal Trace (op-to-op dispatch gap, 98.7% wall-clock) and the MoE sparse_matmul 2-core grids (G=2 chunking). MoE sparse_matmul grid sweep NOT YET run (hang-prone; higher value).

tracy_profiling.notes: Profiled single full-dim SHARDED encoder layer on P150x4 via tracy. Device-time ranking: SparseMatmul(MoE) 62.2%, Slice(chunking) 19.0%, Matmul(dense) 10.5%. tt-perf-report (pipx) installed+used. KEY: op-to-op host gaps ~98.7% of wall-clock -> Metal Trace is the top win. MoE sparse_matmul runs on only 2 cores (G=2 chunk grid); dense linears run HiFi4 (overkill).

perf_analysis.notes: 4 prioritized recs: (1) Metal Trace (traced-execution) ~98.7% wall-clock win; (2) MoE sparse_matmul bf8_b + larger grid / fewer chunks (62% device); (3) reduce expert-chunk Slice overhead, pre-slice at load (19%); (4) dense linears HiFi4->LoFi + bf8_b (10.5%). Device time SOLELY from tracy CSV.

traced_execution.notes: Metal Trace capture/replay validated on sharded encoder layer (raw ttnn begin/end_trace_capture + execute_trace; trace_region_size 400MB). PCC(replay vs normal)=1.000000 delta=0 -> trace is NUMERICALLY EXACT. BUT speedup ~1.0x (NORMAL 43.25ms vs TRACE 43.30ms per forward). HONEST CORRECTION: the earlier tracy 'save 98.7%' figure was a WARM-UP/COMPILE artifact -- steady-state op-to-op gaps are 1-2us (perf_report_steady.txt); with async dispatch the host overlaps, so the layer is DEVICE-COMPUTE-BOUND (43ms dominated by MoE sparse_matmul, the profiled 62%). Trace removes host dispatch only -> no win for this device-bound layer. Real lever = MoE sparse_matmul device compute (2-core G=2 grids). Trace remains correct + may help the full generation loop (more host work). @trace_enabled added for the TracedRun framework path.

decision_log.summary: Localized + fixed the degenerate-token incoherence in the assembled 30-layer P150x4 model.
decision_log.root_cause_primary: POISONED DISK TENSOR CACHE. _ShardedLinearP150x4 / _KVRepeatColParallel / TTNNDiffusionGemmaTextExperts keyed their ttnn.as_tensor disk cache on role+shape+dtype ONLY. A tile written by a different-weights build was silently served for the real weights, corrupting encoder K/V (PCC -0.007) -> garbage decoder hidden -> degenerate-symbol (236772/236761/506) domination. PROOF: _probe_real_step0 regressed 0.9996->0.128 WITH the stale cache, and recovered to 0.999626 with DIFFUSION_GEMMA_NO_CACHE=1; progressive intermediate harness pinpointed ENC_KV_K/V as the first failing boundary (embed+self-cond passed).
decision_log.fix_primary: Added _content_sig(host_tensor) (blake2b of weight bytes) woven into EVERY disk-cache key (sharded linear, kv-repeat, experts) so a weight-value change can never reuse a stale tile. Cleared the poisoned ~48GB cache. After fix: ENC_KV_K/V 0.9999, full 30-layer step-0 argmax-agreement vs HF = 1.0000, degenerate-symbol fraction 0.000.
decision_log.root_cause_secondary: Pipeline hardcoded t_min=0.5/t_max=1.0; the model's HF generation_config is t_min=0.4/t_max=0.8 (entropy_bound 0.1 matched). The entropy-bound sampler is sensitive to the temperature schedule.
decision_log.fix_secondary: PipelineConfig defaults -> t_min=0.4/t_max=0.8; from_hf_model now reads t_min/t_max/entropy_bound from hf_model.generation_config.
decision_log.coherence_finding: HF's OWN reference .generate() on the real 26B model produces EOS/pad collapse for this prompt (raw->'', chat-turn->'\n\n', argmax all-EOS at step0) on CPU bf16 + default gen config. The TTNN model now FAITHFULLY matches HF (full-depth step-0 argmax agreement 1.0, EOS collapse). The degenerate-symbol DEFECT is fixed; human-coherent text is not achievable here because the HF reference itself is not coherent for this prompt/setup (tokenizer has no chat_template) -- outside the TTNN bug scope.
decision_log.residual_note: Full-30-layer raw-logit PCC vs HF = 0.926 (mad~11): documented bf16 multi-layer accumulation drift (S2-DRIFT null hypothesis), gradual not sharp, argmax-preserving -> NOT the incoherence cause. Optional future: fp32 accumulation in MoE sparse_matmul + residual adds.
